narrative: 神秘感落在了朝向镜头的一侧。我们看着那个暗的平面，从远侧受光的脸颊来推断这个人。
黑色电影人像和严肃特写用它，让一张脸被雕刻出来，而不是像证件照一样被呈现。当一个喜剧演员或公众人物应该对我们显得开放时，它就不是合适的工具。
窄面光（Short Lighting）本身不是一种阴影光型：你可以用伦勃朗光（Rembrandt）、环形光（Loop），甚至柔和的包裹光来拍窄面光。它的定义在于哪一侧脸颊朝向镜头，而不是鼻影本身。
how: 转动脸部，让远侧脸颊接受主光（常常与摄影机成45到90度角）。占据画面更大面积的近侧脸颊，则转向阴影。
黑色电影可以用硬光，戏剧场景则可以用中等硬度。颜色跟随主光源。
配合低补光，除非你想让近侧眼睛完全消失。提示词：Short lighting on [Subject], the side turned away from camera is keyed, the near side falls toward shadow, slimming and dramatic.
when: 用它来雕刻一张脸，把神秘感留在摄影机一侧：办公室或夜间酒吧里的特写。当角色正以一种开放、公开的方式向公众展示自己时，就不要用它。
vs: 宽面光（Broad Lighting）照亮朝向镜头的脸颊，正好相反。伦勃朗光是一种常常用窄面光来拍摄的三角光型，但如果三角光斑落在近侧脸颊上，伦勃朗光也可以是宽面的。
分割光（Split Lighting）是一种90度的切割，如果暗的那一半朝向我们，通常就是窄面光。侧光（Side Lighting）描述的是方向，而不是哪一侧脸颊靠近摄影机。
examples_film: 黑色电影人像和《教父》（The Godfather）附近的特写作品，常常把主光打在远侧脸颊上，让摄影机与阴影共处。《毁灭之路》（Road to Perdition）在暗色室内中做了同样的雕刻处理。
看近侧脸颊：如果它是暗的那一侧，你拍的就是窄面光。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是宽面光或正面的蝴蝶光。破绽是一个明亮的近侧脸颊占满了画面。
解决办法是转动脸部，或把主光摆到远侧。

faq.q: 电影中的窄面光是什么？
faq.a: 照亮转离摄影机那一侧脸的布光方式，让朝向镜头的近侧脸颊转向阴影。它让脸显瘦，并增加立体感。

faq.q: 窄面光和宽面光有什么区别？
faq.a: 窄面光照亮远侧脸颊；摄影机看到更多阴影。宽面光照亮近侧脸颊；摄影机看到更多光亮。
用来雕刻一张脸，把神秘感留在摄影机一侧。开放、公开、喜剧式的人像不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示窄面光？
faq.a: 说明转离摄影机的一侧受光，近侧脸颊转向阴影。提及一张显瘦、有立体感的脸。

narrative: Mystery sits on the camera side. We look at the dark plane and infer the person from the far, lit cheek.
Noir portraits and serious close-ups use it so a face is sculpted instead of presented like a passport photo. It is the wrong tool when a comic or public figure should feel open to us.
Short is not a shadow pattern by itself: you can light short as Rembrandt, loop, or even a soft wrap. The definition is which cheek faces the lens, not the nose shadow.
how: Turn the face so the far cheek takes the key (often 45 to 90 degrees from camera). The near cheek, the one occupying more of the frame, goes toward shadow.
Hardness can be hard for noir or medium for drama. Color follows the key source.

Combine with a low fill so the near eye does not die unless you want it to. Prompt: Short lighting on [Subject], the side turned away from camera is keyed, the near side falls toward shadow, slimming and dramatic.
when: Use it to sculpt a face and put mystery on the camera side, a close-up in an office or a night bar. Do not use it when the character is presenting themselves to the public in a broad, open way.
vs: Broad lighting keys the camera-facing cheek, the reverse. Rembrandt lighting is a triangle pattern often shot short, but Rembrandt can be broad if the triangle is on the near cheek.
Split lighting is a 90-degree cut that is usually short if the dark half faces us. Side lighting describes direction, not which cheek is near camera.
examples_film: Portrait noir and Godfather-adjacent close-ups often key the far cheek so the camera sits with the shadow. Road to Perdition does the same sculpting in dark interiors.
Read the near cheek: if it is the dark one, you are short.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is broad lighting or a frontal butterfly. The tell is a bright near cheek filling the frame.
Fix it by turning the face or swinging the key onto the far side.

faq.q: What is short lighting in film?
faq.a: Lighting the side of the face turned away from camera so the near, camera-facing cheek falls toward shadow. It slims and adds dimension.
Short keys the far cheek; the camera sees more shadow. Broad keys the near cheek; the camera sees more light.

faq.q: When should I use short lighting?
faq.a: Use it to sculpt a face and keep mystery on the camera side. Skip it for open, public, comic portraits.

faq.q: How do I prompt short lighting for AI image or video?
faq.a: State that the side turned away from camera is keyed and the near cheek falls toward shadow. Mention a slimming, dimensional face.
